title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments

additional_requirements.scope: D01-D06 product requirements and D-T01-D-T08 conformance. No consensus, monetary or implemented capsule-codec change.

fast_payment_requirements.scope: F01-F06, F-T01-F-T08 and mandatory G9-G11. Design and acceptance requirements for a separately versioned noncustodial fast layer; no baseline consensus or issuance change.

local_usable_receipt.scope: Each predeclared normal local communication/load cohort; original payer authorization/submission through independently verified durable funded recipient state permitting onward payment. No irreversible global or interstellar seconds-finality claim.

daily_payments.composition: Same campaign must meet local latency with genuine signatures, durable funded states, per-payment miner-fee entitlements and declared resource/exit limits; independent reproduction required.

authorization_scope: Owner corrected the whitepaper style by reference to Bitcoin scientific exposition. Rewrite the paper as mechanisms, assumptions and analysis; preserve the previously authorized ordinary-user mining, causal interstellar payment, local fast usability, daily volume and every-payment miner-fee requirements in separate engineering contracts.
qualification: Scientific design exposition only. All previously bound G1-G11, T01-T22, D-T01-D-T08 and F-T01-F-T08 obligations remain mandatory outside the paper. Illustrative fast accounting and capacity estimates do not establish complete state enforcement, per-payment fee completeness, achieved throughput, independent qualification, monetary adoption or an operational stellar route.
acceptance: The implementation plan, acceptance mapping and pinned interstellar/fast-payment requirement contracts retain every prior gate and threshold. Their removal from the paper body is editorial, never a pass, waiver or weakening of the implementation target.
exposition: Mechanism paper: introduction, transactions, open proof of work, survivor difficulty, reorganization, proposed local fast accounting, miner incentives, issuance, interstellar communication, key/storage continuity, security/scaling analysis and conclusion. Engineering gate identifiers, percentile thresholds, campaigns and release checklists remain in independent implementation documents.
